authorized_group_ids.description: QQ groups allowed to run the agent
authorized_group_ids.hint: Empty disables autonomous runs. Add QQ group IDs as strings; * enables every group.

direct_delay_seconds.description: Quiet delay when the bot is mentioned

direct_min_cycle_interval_seconds.description: Minimum interval for directed-message reasoning cycles

max_context_tokens.hint: Uses AstrBot Core's token counter. The latest observation block is trimmed first when it alone exceeds the budget; older records remain searchable through tools.

max_log_records.description: Maximum pending and inflight Buffer records per group
max_log_records.hint: 0 disables the Buffer capacity limit; acknowledged message bodies are deleted.

max_text_chars.description: Maximum stored outline length per message

record_self_messages.description: Record messages sent by the bot account
record_self_messages.hint: Enabled bot echo events can enter later snapshots and start another reasoning cycle.

astrbot_tool_blocklist.description: AstrBot tools to exclude from the autonomous agent
astrbot_tool_blocklist.hint: Tools that conflict with the snapshot/send boundary are excluded by default; additional AstrBot tool names may be appended to block more.

renderer.description: Context rendering format for snapshot observations
renderer.hint: XML Delta Block (Structured Components): single <group_messages_delta> with group metadata and structured event components. Line Messages: compact per-line format with [YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM] (QQ号)昵称: 正文 #message_id, token-efficient for long contexts.

custom_system_prompt.description: Additional persona or group behavior instructions
